mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 12, low 4.

Liverpool are closely monitoring German midfielder Jamal Musiala and may attempt to sign him in the summer if he regains full physical fitness.

American billionaire Todd Boehly has signed an agreement with Russia's oil giant Lukoil to acquire its international assets as part of a consortium that also includes the Russian government.

Fragments of a SpaceX rocket fell in Mexico, prompting the Mexican government to seek a bilateral agreement with the United States to regulate future SpaceX launches.

Journalist Enver Robelli accused KFOR commander General Roberto Vergori of legitimizing Serbian army crimes by meeting Serbian officers in Pristina.

Doruntina Maloku, daughter of slain journalist Enver Maloku, said it is too early to determine whether victims' families have been misled by the Special Court's expectations.
